sources.snippet: Water Presence AutoML Classifier Model Summary This repository contains the best image-classification model selected through a fixed-budget neural-network AutoML search. The model predicts whether a scene contains a visibly identifiable body of water.

sources.title: pakiino/2026-24679-desk-mug-image-hw2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: cannj/2026-24679-desk-mug-dataset. The dataset ships only original (30 source photos) and augmented (300 variants, 10 per photo) splits, so train/validation/test were built here, split at the source-photo level (via parent_id) so a photo's original and all of its augmented copies stay in the same split -- avoiding leakage between splits.
